summary: Structural twin of RenderTextWithShadow: renders a text string twice at caller-supplied position (a1, a2) to create a drop-shadow effect. Both passes format a 64-byte stack buffer via sub_49BB40 / sub_49BBB0 and call UITextRenderWithScale with color 0xFFFFFF at scale 1.0: first a shadow pass (mode 1, alignment 2), then a foreground pass (mode 0, alignment 1). Returns the foreground render result. Called by DrawDebugTextOverlay and UIDebugOverlayRender; not on the tick frame path.

operations.description: Call sub_49BB40(v3, 64): prepare the 64-byte text buffer for the shadow pass.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v3, a1, a2, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0): shadow render pass at position (a1, a2) with mode 1 and alignment 2.
Call sub_49BBB0(v3, 64): prepare the 64-byte text buffer for the foreground pass.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v3, a1, a2, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0): foreground render pass at position (a1, a2) with mode 0 and alignment 1.
Return the integer result of the foreground UITextRenderWithScale call.

unresolved: Meaning of the UITextRenderWithScale mode (1 vs 0) and alignment (2 vs 1) parameters.
